faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Civil Court Khunti Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the Civil Court Khunti Recruitment 2026 is 10th September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Peon/Orderly/Pigeon post?
faq.answer: There are 5 vacancies available for the Peon/Orderly/Pigeon post in the Civil Court Khunti Recruitment 2026. This is a significant number of openings for this position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum educational qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualification required for most of the posts, including Peon/Orderly/Pigeon and Daftari, is Matriculation or an equivalent examination. For the Driver post, a valid Light Motor Vehicle Driving License is also necessary.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to these government jobs?
faq.answer: The age limit for applying to these posts is between 18 years and 35 years. However, age relaxation is provided for certain categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. Are there any application fees for the Civil Court Khunti Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there are no application fees mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Civil Court Khunti Recruitment 2026. This makes the application process more accessible to all eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary structure for the selected candidates?
faq.answer: The salary structure varies based on the post. For Peon/Orderly/Pigeon and Daftari, the salary is in Level-1 (Rs. 18000-56900 per month). For the Driver post, the salary is in Level-2 (Rs. 19900-63200 per month).

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Civil Court Khunti Recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process typically involves a Screening Test, followed by a Skill Test, an Interview, and finally, Document Verification. Candidates need to clear each stage to be considered for the final selection.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates from other states apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification is for Civil Court Khunti, located in Jharkhand. While the official notification should be checked for specific domicile requirements, typically, state government recruitments are open to candidates from across India, subject to eligibility criteria.

faq.question: Q9. How will the application form be submitted?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. Candidates need to download the application form from the official website, fill it out, attach necessary documents, and send it via Speed Post or Registered Post to the address mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of the Civil Court Khunti, which is https://khunti.dcourts.gov.in/. It is crucial to refer to the official website for the most accurate and up-to-date information.
